cases.question: Which farms have Tomato available, and how many kg at each? Return farm name, total available quantity, and unit.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT farm_name, SUM(available) AS available, unit_code FROM v_lot_stock WHERE crop_name='Tomato' AND available>0 AND unit_code='kg' GROUP BY farm_name,unit_code

actual.text: Green Oasis Farm has 78.00 kg of tomatoes available. Al Dhaid Fresh Farm has 220.00 kg of tomatoes available.
actual.sql:
SELECT farm_name, SUM(available) AS total_available, unit_code 
FROM v_lot_stock 
WHERE crop_name = 'Tomato' 
GROUP BY farm_name, unit_code;

cases.question: Which market requests have status PARTIALLY_DELIVERED? Show request ID, market name and status.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT request_id,market_name,status FROM v_request_status WHERE status='PARTIALLY_DELIVERED'

actual.text: Request ID 1 for Al Ain Central Market and Request ID 3 for Sharjah Souq Market both have a status of PARTIALLY_DELIVERED.
actual.sql: SELECT request_id, market_name, status FROM v_request_status WHERE status = 'PARTIALLY_DELIVERED';

cases.question: Which delivery receipts have a shortfall? Show receipt ID, discrepancy quantity and unit.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT d.receipt_id,d.discrepancy_quantity,u.unit_code FROM delivery_receipts d JOIN units u ON u.unit_id=d.unit_id WHERE d.discrepancy_quantity>0

actual.text: Receipt IDs 1, 4, and 6 have shortfalls of 5.00 kg, 5.00 kg, and 8.00 kg, respectively.
actual.sql:
SELECT receipt_id, discrepancy_quantity, u.unit_code 
FROM delivery_receipts dr
JOIN units u ON dr.unit_id = u.unit_id
WHERE dr.discrepancy_quantity > 0;

cases.question: Which harvest lots are past their sell-by date and still have available stock? Show lot ID, crop name, available quantity and unit.
cases.reference_sql: SELECT lot_id,crop_name,available,unit_code FROM v_lot_stock WHERE sell_by_date<CURDATE() AND available>0

actual.text: Lot 3 (Cucumber) is past its sell-by date and has 40.00 kg of stock available.
actual.sql: SELECT lot_id, crop_name, available, unit_code FROM v_lot_stock WHERE sell_by_date < CURDATE() AND available > 0;

cases.question: For Dates, show the available quantity separately for each unit, including zero totals.
